name: Bazaar Commerce
description: Open-source multi-vendor marketplace engine for cash-on-delivery markets.

problemDomain.summary: Ecommerce in markets where roughly 95% of orders are cash on delivery.
constraints: No payment authorization exists, so there is nothing to capture.
Money arrives days later from a courier, in batches, sometimes short.
20-40% of parcels are returned to origin undelivered.
Stripe Connect does not serve many of these markets.

features.name: Cash-on-delivery settlement ledger
capabilities: Double-entry ledger; refuses to write unless debits equal credits
Idempotent on business-fact keys, so replayed courier files and webhooks cannot double-post
Courier remittance ingestion and matching on airway bill
Exception queue: unmatched, amount mismatch, duplicate, overdue
Provincial sales tax on commission and income-tax withholding
Orders become payable only on remittance, not on delivery
keyDecisions: Placement posts nothing: an order is not money.
A mismatched remittance is a dispute, not an automatic adjustment.

features.name: Order confirmation before dispatch (anti-RTO)
capabilities: Holds dispatch until the buyer confirms, enforced in API middleware
RTO risk scoring as a pure function; prepaid and known buyers clear instantly
WhatsApp with SMS fallback, one-tap confirm or cancel link
Escalation queue for human phone calls
Derived, non-stored tokens that stay stable across retries
keyDecisions: Silence is not refusal except in the high-risk band, because most buyers ignore messages.
The gate fails OPEN: a jammed gate costs a seller every order.
Digital-only orders are exempt; there is no parcel to hold.

features.name: Digital code vault and fraud gate
capabilities: AES-256-GCM encrypted code vault, key separate from the session secret
Atomic allocation via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; no code reaches two buyers
Per-seller keyed fingerprints for duplicate-upload rejection
Fraud gate scoring velocity, buyer verification and first-purchase value
Manual review queue with release or refuse
Refundability determined by whether the buyer has seen the code
keyDecisions: The gate fails CLOSED: a released code cannot be recalled.
Refusal requires evidence of fraud, not merely absence of trust.
The reveal is counted before the code is returned.

features.name: Payout rail for markets Stripe Connect does not serve
capabilities: Implements Mercur IPayoutProvider (createPayoutAccount, createOnboarding, createPayout, getWebhookActionAndData)
Driver interface with a mock that models pending KYC and failed disbursements

features.name: Phone-first OTP authentication
capabilities: Hashed codes with timing-safe comparison
Brute-force cap, resend cooldown and hourly ceiling per number
Identical responses for known and unknown numbers, preventing enumeration
Guest checkout that does not create duplicate customers

features.name: Bulk catalogue import and Shopify connector
capabilities: Templated CSV import with row-level errors and no partial imports
Shopify OAuth with expiring token rotation, cost-based throttling and HMAC verification

verification.standard: Every suite was proven able to fail by deliberately breaking the code it covers before it was trusted.

blockedOnCommercialAgreements: Payment service provider (payouts run on a mock driver)
SMS gateway and registered sender mask
WhatsApp Business verification and template approval
Courier contracts, especially COD remittance file formats
